metadata.description: Lifecycle skills and Claude Code mods from the nng kit

plugins.name: lifecycle
plugins.description: Idea-to-shipped skill chain: conduct, brainstorm, make-plan, critique, execute-plan, commit, gh-create-pr, gh-draft-release, gh-tag-release

plugins.name: exec-observe
plugins.description: Live status for /exec runs of Cursor, Antigravity (agy) and Devin fleet plans, in a pane and status line, never in model context

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: Delegate fleet plan implementation to headless Cursor CLI, Google Antigravity CLI, or Devin CLI while Claude Code gates, reviews, and drives the verdict loop: /delegate:execute-via-cursor, /delegate:execute-via-agy, /delegate:execute-via-devin; /delegate:review runs the final whole-branch review through the plan's Review runner

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Cross-surface handoff: save session intent in a git repo or a remote root, pick it up on any Claude surface
